description: This file is a makefile used for building and configuring the glibc package within a build system, specifically for OpenWrt. It includes configuration variables, build steps, and setup routines for cross-compilation.

methods.name: Host/SetToolchainInfo
methods.description: Sets toolchain information such as libc type, URL, version, and shared object version in the info.mk file.

methods.name: Host/Configure
methods.description: Creates build directory, cleans previous configs, and runs the glibc configure script with specified options.

methods.name: Host/Prepare
methods.description: Prepares the build environment and creates a symbolic link for the source directory.

methods.name: Host/Clean
methods.description: Removes build directories and related files to clean the build environment.
